Description:
Isaac (Wei-Chun) Huang is a multidisciplinary Taiwanese engineer/designer with a background in computer science and industrial design. He is passionate about technology and driven to bring innovative ideas to life.

After completing his studies in London, Isaac's curiosity for turning ideas into real-world products led him to pursue a career in software engineering. He began by working with a diverse international team to bring IoT solutions to the pharmaceutical industry. Today, at Agile Robots, he helps shape the software behind the next generation of robotics.
